items.heading: How to register for the Contest?
items.content: Registration takes place through your personal account: complete the registration form. Once all required survey questions are filled out, you officially become a participant of the RuCode Championship! To participate in the Final, you will additionally need to select a venue, division, and create a team.

items.heading: Who can participate?
items.content: School students from 12 years old, university students, IT specialists, and everyone interested in programming can participate.

items.heading: Can I participate without programming experience?
items.content: Yes, choose division E-F for beginners with simple tasks. Helpful materials and courses from RuCode will assist in your preparation, becoming available after registration.

items.heading: Which programming languages are allowed?
items.content: C, C++, Java, Python, Kotlin, Rust

items.heading: Is it required to pass qualifications and training stage to participate in the Final and subsequent stages?
items.content: No, this year no selection is required to participate in the Final — teams can participate in the Final stage directly. Note that the best teams from division A-B and training camp participants will be invited to the Superfinal; see details in the Regulations.

items.heading: Do I need to create my own team or can I participate alone?
items.content: Participation in the training round and online contest is individual; subsequent stages are in teams (up to 3 people). You need to create a team even if you plan to compete solo.

items.heading: What to do if I can't find teammates?
items.content: Participate alone — a team of 1 person is allowed, or find teammates in our social networks: write your city and division to find a team and friends.

items.heading: How to choose a division?
items.content: Based on the results of the training round, a division will be recommended to the participant. Also refer to clause 5 of the regulations: "Contest Divisions and Recommendations for Choosing Them."

items.heading: Will there be merch?
items.content: Yes, all Final participants will receive welcome kits at the contest venues.

items.heading: Will there be certificates? Diplomas?
items.content: Yes. Participants of the online championship, Final, and Superfinal will receive a participation certificate, and the top participants will receive winner and prize diplomas.

items.heading: Where is the Contest held?
items.content: The training and online championships are held in a remote format — you can solve tasks from anywhere in the world. The Final is held in-person at RuCode contest venues in Russia and abroad; in the Superfinal, teams will compete in-person at the RuCode Capital venue.

q4.p1: Yes, only teams whose captain has completed the Qualification Round may advance to the Final.
q4.p2: However, the following categories may skip the Qualification Round and proceed directly to the Final:
winnersList: Winners and prize-winners of ICPC regional finals and semifinals from the past three years;
Winners and prize-winners of the RuCode Final from the past three years;
Winners and prize-winners of the final round of the All-Russian Olympiad in Informatics (AROI) from the past three years;
Winners and prize-winners of national informatics olympiads in BRICS and CIS countries or other friendly nations from the past three years;
q4.p3: Division C–D teams that placed in the top three at a previous RuCode Final may be invited to participate in Division A–B without qualification.
q4.p4: If a team (1 to 3 members) is composed of at least two-thirds ICPC medalists, A–B finalists from the past two years, or national olympiad winners, it is strongly recommended they only compete in Division A–B to ensure fair play

about.title: About the contest
about.description: RuCode Championship is an international algorithmic programming competition where school students, university students, and professionals compete in solving problems by writing efficient and optimized code. The festival is organized by leading universities, public organizations and regional authoutities

stats.content: hosting universities in Russia and friendly countries

aboutDivision.title: RuCode Divisions
aboutDivision.subtitle: Divisions are RuCode Skill Tiers. Participants independently select their division:

items.heading: A-B
items.description: Professional Division. Recommended for competitors with a proven track record in national or international programming olympiads and competitions

items.heading: C-D
items.description: Intermediate Division. Designed for programmers who have mastered foundational algorithms and aim to tackle more complex challenges to advance their skills

items.heading: E-F
items.description: Junior Division. Ideal for beginners and those taking their first steps in programming, offering a supportive environment to build core competencies

content0.text1: Register in your personal account and fill out the application form to get access to useful preparation materials and the opportunity to participate in the online championship
content0.text2: Starting April 27, a practice contest with division selection recommendations begins

content1.text1: The individual online championship is held for all divisions. It is an opportunity to prepare for the Final in the most effective way and to get familiar with the evaluation system

content2.text1: RuCode international training camps are held on the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology campus for teams from Russia, BRICS, and CIS countries and aimed at preparing the strongest teams for the IOI, featuring an intensive educational program

content3.text1: An offline team stage held at venues in Russia and abroad:
content3.text2: All participants receive welcome packs at the venues, as well as participation certificates! The best teams will be awarded diplomas, prizes, and merch
list: 5 hours of challenging and engaging problems

content4.text1: A team round for tops from Divisions A–B and training camps participants. It takes place in person at the RuCode Capital venue, featuring the most challenging problems
content4.text2: Winners receive valuable prizes, diplomas, and widespread recognition!
